title: Exponent interpolation of the f- and g-side estimates for the forest operator bound
intent: Bound the mixed norm ‖∫ x, conj (g x) * ∑ u, carlesonSum (𝔉 u) f x‖ₑ for every exponent q in (1, 2] by proving two separate estimates — forest_operator_g, which carries the bound on g (sharp near q = 2), and forest_operator_f, which carries the bound on f (sharp near q = 1) — then raising them to the complementary powers 2 - 2/q and 2/q - 1, whose sum is 1 and whose product yields the target dens₂ exponent q⁻¹ - 2⁻¹.

parent.name: forest_operator
parent.statement:
theorem forest_operator {n : ℕ} (𝔉 : Forest X n) {f g : X → ℂ}
    (hf : Measurable f) (h2f : ∀ x, ‖f x‖ ≤ F.indicator 1 x)
    (hg : Measurable g) (h2g : ∀ x, ‖g x‖ ≤ G.indicator 1 x) :
    ‖∫ x, conj (g x) * ∑ u with u ∈ 𝔉, carlesonSum (𝔉 u) f x‖ₑ ≤
    C2_0_4 a q n * (dens₂ (⋃ u ∈ 𝔉, 𝔉 u)) ^ (q⁻¹ - 2⁻¹) *
    eLpNorm f 2 volume * eLpNorm g 2 volume

children.name: forest_operator_g
children.statement:
lemma forest_operator_g (t : Forest X n)
    (hf : Measurable f) (h2f : ∀ x, ‖f x‖ ≤ F.indicator 1 x)
    (hg : Measurable g) (h2g : ∀ x, ‖g x‖ ≤ G.indicator 1 x) :
    ‖∫ x, conj (g x) * ∑ u with u ∈ t, carlesonSum (t u) f x‖ₑ ≤
    G2_0_4 a n * eLpNorm f 2 volume * eLpNorm g 2 volume
children.closed_by: calc; forest_operator_g_prelude hf h2f hg h2g, then forest_operator_g_main hg h2g
children.note: The g-side estimate: bounds the integral with constant G2_0_4 a n and no dens₂ factor, sharp near q = 2.

children.name: forest_operator_f
children.statement:
lemma forest_operator_f (t : Forest X n)
    (hf : Measurable f) (h2f : ∀ x, ‖f x‖ ≤ F.indicator 1 x)
    (hg : Measurable g) (h2g : ∀ x, ‖g x‖ ≤ G.indicator 1 x) :
    ‖∫ x, conj (g x) * ∑ u with u ∈ t, carlesonSum (t u) f x‖ₑ ≤
    C2_0_4_aux a * dens₂ (⋃ u ∈ t, t u) ^ (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ *
    eLpNorm f 2 volume * eLpNorm g 2 volume
children.closed_by: calc; forest_operator_f_prelude hf h2f hg h2g, then forest_operator_f_main hf h2f
children.note: The f-side estimate: bounds the integral with constant C2_0_4_aux a * dens₂^(1/2), sharp near q = 1.

applicability.goal_shape: A bound on a bilinear expression ‖∫ x, conj (g x) * (∑ᵢ Fᵢ f x)‖ₑ (here the forest operator applied to f and tested against g) that must hold for a parameter q in (1, 2], where two complementary estimates of the same quantity are available: one carrying only g (forest_operator_g), one carrying f plus a dens₂ factor (forest_operator_f).
applicability.use_when: Two bounds on the same quantity hold with complementary strengths and the target bound is a geometric mean of them: there are exponents θ and 1 - θ with θ + (1 - θ) = 1 such that raising the two bounds to those powers and multiplying gives the target exponent and constant.
applicability.avoid_when: Only one side has a useful estimate, or the two estimates do not bound the same object so their product cannot be formed; the bookkeeping that the product of the two constants equals the target constant is non-trivial and needs its own calc; the interpolation degenerates at an endpoint (q = 2), which must be split off as a separate case.

consequences: Creates two named estimates plus three arithmetic side-conditions the glue must discharge: the two powers are positive (egpos, efpos, needed for rpow_le_rpow_iff), they sum to 1 (esum), and the product of the two constants equals the target C2_0_4 (the final calc). At the endpoint q = 2 the power 2 - 2/q is 0, so the interpolation degenerates and the theorem branches on rcases (q_le_two X).eq_or_lt, closing the endpoint by convert g_part using 6; ring instead. If the two sides did not share the same eLpNorm f 2 * eLpNorm g 2 tail, their product would not simplify to the target form.
